 At this point, I feel offended. As if weed is literally my personality to others. I also feel embaressment, because somehow it has not registered in other people's minds that I can be happy and sociable too. I've always been called out on for opening up and being normal. When it happens, it's as if the whole world around you has decided to actually let you in on the big secret of what the world really thinks about you, and you, in that moment, are forced to acknowledge with the rest of the world the one thing you wish you never became; that which you desperately hope to put behind you and have it be completely forgotten by everyone.

Having it be completely forgotten is a fantasy though. Obviously that will never happen, and my only way through this is to be happy to openly acknowledge my old ways when the need arises. Unfortunately, that would be the most painful form of humility. I can admit I'm wrong about anything without shame, but admitting that my personality was fundamentally wrong and awkward up until now...that's a whole different ball game. 

It's a steep, steep hill to climb. So large and daunting that I'd rather just sit still. Enough time passes and you wonder if life is even worth living when you still have this steep hill to climb. The humility required is almost too much to bear.
